name: grand_totals_full_business_and_comparable
purpose: Show the headline totals for the comparable branches and the current-only contribution from the new branch.
intent: Return one row with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] for the like-for-like branches only by applying the branch filter to all four required tables: 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] with values CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021. dax:
EVALUATE
UNION(
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ROW(
            "Scope", "Like-for-like",
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    ),
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ROW(
            "Scope", "CFH022",
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", BLANK(),
            "revenue Growth", BLANK(),
            "revenue growth %", BLANK(),
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", BLANK(),
            "QTY Growth", BLANK(),
            "QTY GROWTH %", BLANK(),
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", BLANK(),
            "bills growth %", BLANK(),
            "retail price current year", BLANK(),
            "retail price past year", BLANK(),
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", BLANK(),
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", BLANK(),
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", BLANK(),
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", BLANK(),
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", BLANK(),
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", BLANK(),
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", BLANK()
        ),
        TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH022"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),

)

name: latest_month_store_summary
purpose: Show which like-for-like branches drove the latest monthly result.
intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that single month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] descending.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no],
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({LatestMonth}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
    ),
    [net revenue CURRENT], DESC
)

name: latest_month_division_breakdown
purpose: Identify the main division-level contributors within the latest comparable month.
intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return the top 15 rows sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonthInScope =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    )
VAR DivisionTable =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({LatestMonthInScope}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month])
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        DivisionTable,
        "__SortAbsRevenueGrowth", ABS([revenue Growth])
    ),
    [__SortAbsRevenueGrowth], DESC,
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name], ASC
)

name: latest_month_category_movers
purpose: Surface the biggest category gains and declines in the latest comparable month.
intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return a paired tails set made from the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] descending and the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] ascending, with final sort by [revenue Growth] descending.
dax:
VAR __Branches = { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }
VAR __LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    )
VAR __Base =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS(__Branches, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({ __LatestMonth }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({ __LatestMonth }, 'CAT_TABLE'[month]),
        TREATAS({ __LatestMonth }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[month]),
        TREATAS({ __LatestMonth }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[month])
    )
VAR __TopGains =
    TOPN(7, __Base, [revenue Growth], DESC, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC)
VAR __TopDeclines =
    TOPN(7, __Base, [revenue Growth], ASC, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC)
RETURN
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    14,
    DISTINCT(
        UNION(
            __TopGains,
            __TopDeclines
        )
    ),
    [revenue Growth], DESC,
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC
)

name: latest_daily_transactions_branch
purpose: Add current-period branch transaction context from the daily table without using it for year-on-year comparison.
intent: Using 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt', first determine the latest date at or before 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[max_date] that has nonblank values in 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]. For that latest valid date, group by 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE] and compute true branch Transactions by taking the daily branch-level value once per date, not by summing repeated rows, using the level-specific column 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]. Return up to 15 rows sorted by the computed Transactions descending. Do not include any last-year comparison because this table has current-year data only.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestValidDate =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE],
                "MaxDateValue", MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[max_date]),
                "DailyLocBills", MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS])
            ),
            'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] <= [MaxDateValue]
                && NOT ISBLANK([DailyLocBills])
        ),
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE],
        TREATAS({ LatestValidDate }, 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
        "Transactions",
            SUMX(
                VALUES('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
                CALCULATE(MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]))
            )
    ),
    [Transactions], DESC
)
